analysis.strategyReview: Our content strategy shows strong coverage across all five pillars with 60 published posts, demonstrating comprehensive market education. We've established authority in vertical-specific playbooks (insurance, mortgage, solar) and built solid foundations in compliance and channel tactics. However, analysis reveals gaps in advanced optimization content, particularly around data analytics, predictive modeling, and sophisticated CRM automation that enterprise-level operations need. We're also light on seasonal/timing-based strategies and cross-vertical lead arbitrage opportunities that experienced operators pursue.
analysis.competitiveInsights: Competitive analysis reveals AgedLeadStore.com focuses heavily on product features but lacks strategic depth around lead scoring algorithms and multi-channel attribution modeling. HowToWorkLeads.com provides generic advice but misses industry-specific compliance nuances and vertical-specific conversion psychology. Key opportunity gaps include: AI-powered lead prioritization (high search volume, low competition), seasonal lead buying strategies by vertical, and advanced metrics like lead velocity scoring. Trending searches show increased interest in 'lead scoring software', 'aged lead ROI calculator', and 'insurance lead conversion rates by source'.
